Overview: UniFi OS 6.0.17 includes the improvements and bugfixes below.
Improvements: Added configurable backup schedules, multiple backup destinations, local backup management, and an improved restore experience.
Added a configurable session duration for Remember Me in Local Login.
Added Console resource reporting to Control Plane settings.
Added support for internationalized domain names in automatic certificates.
Added application update guidance when an adopted device requires a newer application version.
Added a STARTTLS option for custom mail servers.
Added a manual override for device upgrades, reboots, and resets during critical operations.
Improved storage reliability and resiliency.
Improved application installation resiliency.
Improved WAN SLA reliability.
Improved reporting to Site Manager
Improved system reliability
Improved mDNS stability
Improved UniFi OS backup restore reliability.
Improved application update behavior after firmware updates by only updating applications with auto-update enabled.
Improved ownership transfers with a clearer pending status.
Transfers to UI Accounts now complete after the recipient accepts the invitation.
Improved DNS and DHCP resiliency under heavy device load.
Improved Application Rollback resiliency.
Improved DNS resiliency when DNS-over-HTTPS providers rotate their server certificates.
Improved time synchronization resiliency.
Improved authentication reliability during two-factor challenges.
Improved Bluetooth reliability during setup.
Improved SFP negotiation speed.
Improved 1 Gbps link reliability when using the UACC-CM-RJ45-MG SFP module.
Improved Shadow Mode resiliency.
Upgraded the Debian distribution to Trixie.
[UDM/UDM-Pro/UDM-SE/UDM-Pro-Max] Improved PPPoE throughput for IPv6.
[UDM-Pro/UDM-SE/UDM-Pro-Max] Added LAG support for SFP ports.
[UDM-Pro-Max/UDM-Beast] Improved storage resiliency during RAID reshape operations.
[UDM-Pro-Max/UDM-Beast] Improved RAID scrubbing.
[UDM-Beast] Improved hardware offloading.
Bugfixes: Fixed an issue where WAN failover could trigger unnecessary DHCP renewals.
Fixed an issue where Policy-Based Routing could fail when many WireGuard tunnels were connected.
Fixed an issue where Network Application updates were not displayed when the application failed to start.
Fixed an issue where VPN client DNS settings could affect DNS resolution for all LAN clients.
Fixed connectivity issues affecting WireGuard VPNs.
Fixed an issue where Add New Person could become unresponsive when Remote Access was disabled.
Fixed an issue where DHCP leases could become corrupted after a High Availability failover, causing clients to receive incorrect IP addresses.
Fixed an issue where PPPoE configuration errors could cause connection instability.
Fixed an issue where heavy DNS traffic during a network outage could cause system instability when Content Filtering or Ad Blocking was enabled.
Fixed an issue where Honeypot alerts could stop being reported after a large number of detections.
Fixed an issue where WireGuard clients using IPv6 could lose connectivity after the WAN IPv6 prefix changed.
Fixed an issue where WAN interfaces using MAC Cloning could fail to obtain an IP address after reconnecting the cable.
Fixed an issue where deleting a network using a delegated IPv6 prefix could cause other networks to change IPv6 addresses after a reboot.
Fixed an issue where WAN DHCP connectivity could drop.
Fixed an IPS/IDS SIP signature parsing issue.
Fixed an issue where a disabled port could become enabled again after a reboot.
Fixed incorrect At Risk status reporting for disks with an extremely high power cycle count.
Fixed an issue where the Dashboard could show no data and all ports could appear offline after upgrading when using PPPoE with additional IP addresses.
Fixed an issue where a LAN DNS server could become unreachable after a reboot when Honeypot was enabled on the network.
Fixed an issue where OpenVPN connections using an imported configuration with AES-256-CBC could fail to establish.
Fixed an issue where DNS resolution for Policy-Based Routing could fail after restoring a backup that changed the WAN connection type.
Fixed issues where a Shadow console could remain offline or fail to synchronize UniFi Network after a primary restart or failback.
Fixed an issue where large UniFi Network backups could time out before completion.
Fixed an issue where reinstalled applications could later stop because a previously disabled state was retained.
Fixed an issue where declining an invitation could remove an existing administrator's cloud identity or permissions.
Fixed an issue where the factory reset confirmation could obscure the critical operation review dialog.
Fixed missing application update failure events in System Log.
Fixed an issue where UniFi Endpoint invitations could incorrectly show Specific Wi-Fi Connection Required when connected to the correct network.
Fixed an issue where blocked flows were not shown for the Block Invalid Traffic Firewall Policy.
Fixed an issue where Sent and Received traffic values were reversed in Traffic Info.
Fixed an issue where application and category information could be missing in Traffic Flows.
Fixed an issue where Ad Blocking could prevent some websites from functioning correctly.
Fixed an issue where multiple PPPoE WAN connections could use DNS servers from the wrong ISP.
Fixed an issue where scheduled Firewall and Content Filtering rules could apply incorrectly on Sundays.
Fixed link-local addresses being incorrectly reported as WAN addresses.
Fixed an issue where Alarm Manager emails were not sent to local administrators when Remote Access was disabled.
Fixed an issue where device lists could fail to synchronize with the cloud on consoles managing large numbers of devices.
Fixed an issue where console configurations could fail to synchronize with Fabric after switching organizations.
Fixed an issue where application updates could install a different version than the one displayed as available.
[UDM] Fixed an issue where some switch ports could become disabled after an upgrade.
[UDM-Pro/UDM-SE/UDM-Pro-Max/UDM-Beast] Fixed an issue where Shadow Mode setup could fail after a temporary connection loss to the primary console.
[UDM-Pro/UDM-SE/UDM-Pro-Max/UDM-Beast] Fixed an issue where a Shadow Mode gateway could fail to become active after a failover.
[UDM-Pro-Max/UDM-Beast] Fixed incorrect Storage Not Initialized warnings and Erase and Format prompts when drive bays were empty and built-in storage was healthy.
[UDM-Beast] Fixed missing Virtual Network Override options.
[UDM-Beast] Fixed an issue where hardware offloading did not work correctly in Shadow Mode.
[UDM-Beast] Fixed an issue where High Availability setup could fail when using a custom Native VLAN on the sync port.
[UDM-Beast] Fixed an issue where Deep Inspection domain category updates could cause the device to run out of memory and restart.
[UDM-Pro/UDM-SE/UDM-Pro-Max/UDM-Beast] Fixed a compatibility issue with 4Kn disks.
